name: mzn-vagas
description: A local job-search copilot: track your applications, get a fit analysis per job and rehearse every interview stage (HR, technical, client, system design…) by text or voice with YOUR AI. Your data stays on your machine.

scripts.start: npm run build && NODE_ENV=production tsx server/main.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run vagas:validate -- --all --workspace test/fixtures/sample-workspace && npm run vagas:schemas -- --check && npm run privacy:check && npm run evals && npm run build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron .
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.desktop:release: npm run build && npm run desktop:compile && electron-builder --publish always

author: Find Dreams contributors
